import MumfordLib.BarycentricSubdivisionSupport
import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionIteration
import MumfordLib.SingularSubdivisionSmallness
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecificLimits.Basic

/-!
# Eventual smallness of subdivided singular simplices

The geometric mesh estimate tends to zero under iterated barycentric
subdivision. The Lebesgue-number bound for a singular simplex therefore makes
every sufficiently subdivided chain subordinate to an open cover.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite Filter
open scoped Simplicial Topology

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X : TopCat} {n : ℕ}

/-- Every sufficiently high subdivision of a singular simplex factors through
the chains subordinate to an open cover. -/
theorem singularSimplexChain_eventually_subdivision_small_factor
    {ι : Type*} (U : ι → Set X) (hopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ U i)
    (σ : (TopCat.toSSet.obj X).obj (op ⦋n⦌)) :
    ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K,
      ∃ c : ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ (IntegralSmallSingularChainComplex X U).X n,
        c ≫ (smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n =
          singularSimplexChain σ ≫ (End.of (singularSubdivision X n)) ^ k := by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hsmall⟩ := singularSimplex_exists_small_diameter X U hopen hcover σ
  let D := Metric.diam (Set.univ : Set (stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
  have hD₀ : 0 ≤ D := Metric.diam_nonneg
  have hD (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
      dist (stdSimplex.vertex i : stdSimplex ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
        (stdSimplex.vertex j) ≤ D :=
    Metric.dist_le_diam_of_mem isCompact_univ.isBounded
      (Set.mem_univ _) (Set.mem_univ _)
  have hq₀ : 0 ≤ (n : ℝ) / (n + 1) := by positivity
  have hq₁ : (n : ℝ) / (n + 1) < 1 := by
    exact (div_lt_one (by positivity)).mpr (by linarith)
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun k : ℕ => ((n : ℝ) / (n + 1)) ^ k * D) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa only [zero_mul] using
      (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one hq₀ hq₁).mul_const D
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := eventually_atTop.mp (hlim.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε))
  refine ⟨K, fun k hk => ?_⟩
  let P : Submodule ℤ (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ ⟶ (IntegralSingularChainComplex X).X n) :=
    LinearMap.range (Linear.rightComp ℤ (ModuleCat.of ℤ ℤ)
      ((smallSingularChainInclusion X U).f n))
  have hmem : singularSimplexChain σ ≫ (End.of (singularSubdivision X n)) ^ k ∈ P := by
    rw [singularSimplexChain_subdivision_pow, ← Category.assoc]
    apply vertexListChain_span_comp_mem _ _ P ?_
      (barycentricSubdivision_pow_mesh_mem hD₀ (vertexListChain_mem_mesh _ hD) k)
    intro v hv
    have hvsmall := hsmall n (affineSimplexMap v)
      ((affineSimplexMap_diam_le v (mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hq₀ k) hD₀) hv).trans_lt
        (hK k hk))
    rw [vertexListChain_affineSingularEvaluation]
    exact ⟨(smallSingularSubcomplex X U).toSSet.ιChainComplex ⟨_, hvsmall⟩,
      smallSingularChainInclusion_simplex X U _⟩
  exact hmem

end Mumford.Analytic
